Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.engine

Class TurnScheduler

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.engine.TurnScheduler
public class TurnScheduler extends Object
Orders the actions of all actors on the current floor by game time.

The player is just another actor, but the player's actions come from commands rather than from Actor.act(edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.engine.GameSession). After the player acts, runUntil(edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.engine.Actor, edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.engine.GameSession) lets every other actor whose turn comes first take its action, and returns as soon as it is the player's turn again.

    • peekNext

      public Actor peekNext()

    • runUntil

      public void runUntil(Actor stopAt, GameSession session)
      Runs actors in time order until it is stopAt's turn or the game is no longer in progress.
      Parameters:
      stopAt - the actor whose turn ends the loop (normally the player)
      session - the game, passed to each actor
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if stopAt is not scheduled, or if actors keep acting without the player's turn arriving (a runaway loop)

    • reschedule

      public void reschedule(Actor actor, long delay)
      Moves an already-scheduled actor's next turn to delay ticks from now. Used when the player returns to a floor whose actors were scheduled at an older time.
      Parameters:
      actor - the actor to re-schedule
      delay - ticks from now until its next action
